intent: To demonstrate that a majority of U.S. adults expressed at least some confidence in police officers to act in the public's best interests in late 2020.

requirements.question: Is the combined 74% at-least-some figure obligatory even though it is derived rather than printed?
Must the exact 26% great-deal value be shown?
Must the exact 48% fair-amount value be shown even though the narration does not name it?

units.claim: Combining the two reported confidence levels, 74% of U.S. adults expressed at least some confidence in police to act in the public's best interests.
accept: about three-quarters said a great deal or a fair amount
26% great deal plus 48% fair amount equals 74% at least some confidence
units.evidence: The chart must show both the 26% and 48% components or a combined 74% 'at least some' segment.

units.claim: 26% of U.S. adults said they had a great deal of confidence in police to act in the public's best interests.
accept: about one-quarter reported a great deal of confidence
units.evidence: The 'A great deal' bar/segment must be labeled or readable as 26%.

units.claim: 48% of U.S. adults said they had a fair amount of confidence in police to act in the public's best interests.
accept: about half reported a fair amount of confidence
units.evidence: The 'A fair amount' bar/segment must be labeled or readable as 48%.

optional_valid: A fair amount was the most common of the two shown confidence levels (48%).
The great-deal share (26%) is about one-quarter of adults.
The fair-amount share (48%) is roughly half of adults.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
